cases.title: A one-pair focus gets a walkthrough, not a demo that does the whole lesson

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 0.5 s, inside the focus pair Glow › Blurriness 0–1 s, and the reply refers to it: "Above is 0.5 s, the middle of that pair. Right now the blur changes at exactly the same rate the whole second."

No set_ease runs (demo_target is null, no_demo_reason single_pair); the mentor names the pair ("Effects › Gaussian Blur › Blurriness, from 0 s to 1 s"), gives steps, and asks the learner to try it and say "done". The optional Title demo would still leave three pairs for the learner.
